data.name: Rehobo
data.gender_notes: Rehobo is used as a male name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: In the Bible, Rehoboam was the name of King Solomon's son and successor. The name Rehoboam means 'wide' or 'roomy' in Hebrew, reflecting the expansive rule of the Israelite kingdom under his reign. The name Rehobo carries the meaning “Open country; wide; roomy” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Hebrew. Parents who choose Rehobo usually hope their child will grow to embody open country; wide; roomy and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes expansiveness and abundance in spiritual growth and faith.
data.etymology: Rehobo belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “Open country; wide; roomy.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Rehobo total 9, giving a life-path number of 9. Number 9 is linked with Mars and with the qualities of compassion, idealism and generosity.

in_hebrew.name: רהבו
in_hebrew.meaning: רחבו בן עבידע - God has made room or enlarged
in_hebrew.long_meaning: השם רהבו נגזר משורש רחב, שפירושו להתרחב או להרשות. במשמעותו המקראית, השם עשוי להת关联 עם הגדלת או הרחבת גבולות, והוא עשוי לשאת משמעות רוחנית של גדילה או התרחבות ביחס לאלוקים.

in_greek.name: Ρηχωβω
in_greek.meaning: Ο Θεός επλατυνε or made room
in_greek.long_meaning: Το όνομα Ρηχωβω προέρχεται από την εβραϊκή λέξη רחב, που σημαίνει να διευρύνω ή να κάνω ευρύ. Στην πνευματική σημασία, το όνομα συνδέεται με την ανάπτυξη ή την επέκταση στα πλαίσια της σχέσης με τον Θεό.

in_latin.name: Rehobo
in_latin.long_meaning: Nomen Rehobo derivatur a verbo hebraico רחב, quod significat dilatare seu ampliare. In contextu spirituali, nomen hoc refert ad incrementum seu dilatationem in relatione ad Deum.

in_english.name: Rehobo
in_english.meaning: God has made room or enlarged
in_english.long_meaning: The name Rehobo originates from the Hebrew root רחב (Rahab), meaning 'to make room' or 'to enlarge'. It carries a spiritual significance of growth or expansion in one's relationship with God, reflecting themes of abundance and divine providence. Historically, names with similar roots are found in biblical contexts, symbolizing divine intervention and blessing.

celebrity_usage: Rehoboam, a character in the Bible
data.cultural_impact: The name Rehoboam represents the idea of expansiveness, not only in terms of territorial control but also in terms of opportunities and possibilities. It evokes images of a vast, prosperous and thriving kingdom.
data.spiritual_significance: The name Rehoboam also holds profound spiritual significance, reminding us of the expansiveness of God's love and grace. It serves as a reminder of the boundless opportunities for growth, transformation, and renewal that are available to us through a deep and meaningful relationship with Him. Ultimately, the name Rehoboam encourages us to embrace the wide-ranging possibilities of the spiritual journey and to trust in God's guidance and sovereignty every step of the way.
data.spiritual_symbolism: Rehoboth, meaning "wide or spacious places," symbolizes the boundless love and grace of God in our lives, providing room for growth, exploration, and the expansion of faith.

biblical_reference.note: Rehoboam's father was Abijah, and his name might be considered in similar etymological context.

historical_references.reference: The name Rehoboth is mentioned in the Old Testament, specifically in Genesis 26:22 where it is said that Isaac built an altar there and called upon the name of the Lord, after God had appeared to him and promised to bless him. Rehoboth was located in the land of Gerar in the region of the Negev.
historical_references.context: Isaac's journey and settlement in the land of Canaan

historical_references.reference: Another reference to Rehoboth can be found in 2 Chronicles 32:31, where it is mentioned that Hezekiah, king of Judah, built a pool and a conduit in the city of David, called the Upper Pool or the Pool of Siloam, which he also covered with millstones. The Pool of Siloam was near the 'Going Up to the Temple', and also near the 'Great Shaft', which was a tunnel leading to the Siloam Pool. The Pool of Siloam was also called the 'Rehoboth Pool' due to its size and significance.

modern_usage.modern_context: In today's world, the name Rehobo continues to be cherished by Christian families globally. It is frequently featured on social media platforms where parents share their naming journeys, and Christian name websites where expectant parents research meaningful Biblical names. The name bridges traditional Christian values with modern faith identity, making it relevant for contemporary families seeking names with deep spiritual and Biblical significance.

name_in_real_life.story: John Rehobo from Dublin, Ireland embodies the meaning of Rehobo - "Open country; wide; roomy". Raised in a Christian family, they were taught to honor the significance of their name and walk in faith throughout their life.
